about_the_game:
A family curse. A deadly heirloom. A race against time.

Hidden Legacy: Dark Heirloom is a captivating hidden-object puzzle adventure where dark family secrets and supernatural mysteries collide.

For generations, the Montgomery family has been haunted by a mysterious ring said to bring death to all who wear it. Renowned genealogist Gabriel Vanyard is no stranger to family secrets, but this cursed artifact is unlike anything he’s ever faced.

From the misty Irish countryside to the towering Scottish Highlands, Gabriel must unravel a dark history before the last Montgomery meets a tragic fate. Will he break the curse, or will the family’s legacy end in ruin?

🔹 Unlock a chilling bonus chapter to uncover the haunting aftermath of the cursed painting!
🔹 Explore eerie and breathtaking locations, from shadowed estates to ancient ruins hiding long-lost secrets.
🔹 Solve intricate puzzles and mini-games to piece together the truth behind the Montgomery curse.
🔹 Find hidden collectibles and extra content to deepen the mystery and uncover even more secrets.

The past is calling, will you dare to answer?
